**Plex links that land on the item, and newsletters that read right**

- **Plex links open the item.** Links through `https://app.plex.tv` now use the same form as Tautulli's, so people reach the movie or show even when Plex first asks them to sign in or pick a profile.
- **TV rows link to the season or show.** A row grouping several new episodes links to their season, or to the show when they span seasons. Each listed episode still links to itself.
- **The right verb in each section.** Source buttons say **Listen on** under Audiobooks, **Read on** under Books, **Watch on** under Movies and TV, and **Play on** under Games.
- **BookOrbit synopses.** BookOrbit books and audiobooks now show a short synopsis, like movies.

Thanks again to [@crispybegs](https://github.com/crispybegs) for testing each fix and finding the Plex link format in [#353](https://github.com/jshields-ca/LatestArr/issues/353), and for suggesting the synopsis in [#359](https://github.com/jshields-ca/LatestArr/issues/359).
